title.zh: Anthropic三季度营收168亿美元 拟将5%股份注入公益基金
title.en: Anthropic posts $16.8B Q3, pledges 5% of shares to public-benefit fund

summary.zh: Anthropic三季度营收168亿美元、环比增长45%，并承诺将5%股份投入公益基金。
summary.en: Anthropic reported $16.8B in Q3 revenue, up 45% sequentially, and committed 5% of its shares to a public-benefit fund.

title.zh: 美国禁止联邦民事机构使用DeepSeek
title.en: US bars DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies

summary.zh: 美国禁止联邦民事机构和政府合同使用DeepSeek；中国提议将境外托管受限AI模型视为出口。
summary.en: The US barred DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies and contracts; China proposed treating overseas hosting of restricted models as exports.

title.zh: 特朗普暂缓对俄新措施以保护乌克兰和谈
title.en: Trump holds off on new Russia measures

summary.zh: 特朗普决定暂不对俄罗斯采取新措施，以保护乌克兰和平谈判。
summary.en: Trump held off on new Russia measures to protect Ukraine peace talks.

title.zh: 加拿大军事基地火灾致4死
title.en: Fire at Canadian military base kills four

summary.zh: 加拿大一处军事基地发生火灾，造成4人死亡、数十人受伤。
summary.en: A fire at a Canadian military base killed four and injured dozens.

title.zh: 巴黎再爆冲突 抗议被捕人数逾2000
title.en: Paris clashes renew as protest arrests top 2,000

summary.zh: 巴黎再次发生冲突，抗议相关被捕人数已超过2000人；美国驻中东使馆发布安全警告。
summary.en: Clashes resumed in Paris with more than 2,000 protest arrests, while the US warned Americans in the Middle East.

title.zh: AI与芯片股反弹 纳指涨1.1%
title.en: AI and chip stocks rebound; Nasdaq up 1.1%

summary.zh: 10月19日纳指涨1.11%，标普500涨0.41%，AI信贷担忧缓解。
summary.en: The Nasdaq rose 1.11% and the S&P 500 0.41% on Oct. 19 as AI credit worries eased.

title.zh: 国家统计局：前三季度GDP同比增长4.6%
title.en: China's GDP grows 4.6% in first three quarters

summary.zh: 前三季度国内生产总值1071071亿元，同比增长4.6%；三季度增长4.5%，环比增长1.2%。
summary.en: China's GDP reached 107.1 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 4.6%; Q3 grew 4.5% year on year and 1.2% quarter on quarter.

body.zh:
国家统计局10月19日发布数据，前三季度国内生产总值1071071亿元，按不变价格计算同比增长4.6%。

分季度看，一季度增长5.0%，二季度增长4.3%，三季度增长4.5%；三季度GDP环比增长1.2%。新华网评论称，前三季度增速符合全年经济预期增长目标。
body.en:
China's statistics bureau said GDP reached 107.1 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 4.6% at constant prices ([NBS](https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202610/t20261019_1965618.html)).

Growth was 5.0% in Q1, 4.3% in Q2 and 4.5% in Q3, with Q3 up 1.2% on the quarter. Xinhua said the pace is in line with the full-year target.
